name: ANHALONIUM LEWINII
key_symptoms: Aches, with disturbed vision. Fantastic, brilliant, moving colored objects. Affected by beating time. Pupils dilated, vertigo, brain tired. Polychrome spectra. Exaggerated reverberation of ordinary sounds.
guiding_symptoms: Aches, with disturbed vision. Fantastic, brilliant, moving colored objects. Affected by beating time. Pupils dilated, vertigo, brain tired. Polychrome spectra. Exaggerated reverberation of ordinary sounds.
mind_symptoms: Loss of conception of time. Difficult enunciation. Distrust and resentment. Lazy contentment.
